other_conditions: Must be a serving State Government employee as defined in West Bengal Service Rules.
Employees already covered under other government housing schemes such as Pratyasha for Policemen are ineligible.
Application must be submitted online only, with a single application per applicant and a Rs. 25,000 application fee payable via Bank of Baroda challan.
benefits_summary: Provides housing to serving West Bengal State Government employees on a transparent lottery basis, with flats allocated based on grade pay.
